lines: Yemeni civil war Houthi–Saudi conflict October 2026 attacks on Saudi Arabia airports The Houthis claim to have attacked King Khalid International Airport with a ballistic missile for a third consecutive day. (Reuters)

2026 Nobel Prizes American economists Robert Ernest Hall and Michael Dean Woodford are jointly awarded the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences for "microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation". (CNN)
One person is killed and four others are injured after an accident on the Goliath roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia in Mableton, Georgia, United States. (BNO News)
A fire destroys the historic Marché des Enfants Rouges [fr] food market in Paris, France. (France 24)
2026 Aubagne school shooting A 14-year-old student opens fire at a middle school in Aubagne, France, injuring two staff members, before being detained. (France24)

2026 Khyber Pakhtunkhwa state of emergency Pakistan's federal government detains hundreds of Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) members, including former Khyber Pakhtunkhwa chief minister Sohail Afridi and other provincial officials, after suspending the PTI-led provincial administration and imposing emergency rule. (AFP via RFI)
The criminal trial of Russell Brand on charges of rape and sexual assault begins with jury selection. (BBC)
A cyber attack without attribution against French supermarkets results in losses worth millions of euros. (BBC)
2026 Estonian presidential election Ülle Madise, who was elected by the Riigikogu last 2 September, takes office as President of Estonia, succeeding Alar Karis. (Estonian World)
